analysis_type: post hoc descriptive raw-measurement diagnostic; original labels and predictions frozen
statistical_intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for proportions; conditional on retained cohorts, not full-chain model intervals
privacy: record-level derivation restricted locally; aggregate outputs only
publication: Included in v3.4.0; the 39-check raw-extraction log precedes the added metadata sensitivity check.

metadata_sensitivity.comparison: Original algorithmic opportunity versus excluding unusable discharge stops
metadata_sensitivity.exact_counts: Withheld from public output to prevent complementary disclosure of small cells
metadata_sensitivity.interpretation: Metadata-restricted sensitivity, not confirmation of complete testing or postdischarge outcomes
metadata_sensitivity.plan_deviation: Unusable discharge combines missing, parsing failure and nonpositive duration; causes and effective death truncation are not separately enumerated

public_output_postprocessing: Small-cell counts and linked fields suppressed in the analytical writer; raw-reconciliation checks retained from full extraction
